title: Centralised identity inventory
assertion: Every evaluated account is sourced from an approved enterprise identity provider and is uniquely attributable.
expected_value: provider is approved and id is non-empty
evidence_sources: Identity provider account export; tenant metadata
notes: External framework tags are crosswalk indicators and require assessor validation for engagement scope.

title: Unique user identities
assertion: Shared user accounts are not present outside explicitly approved break-glass scope.
expected_value: false unless break_glass is true
evidence_sources: Identity account inventory; exception register
notes: External framework tags are crosswalk indicators and require assessor validation for engagement scope.

title: Disabled stale accounts
assertion: Human accounts inactive beyond the approved threshold are disabled or removed.
expected_value: enabled is false when last_sign_in_days exceeds threshold
evidence_sources: Identity sign-in logs; account status export
notes: Threshold is set by local policy and recorded with evidence.

title: Joiner mover leaver timeliness
assertion: Identity lifecycle changes are completed within the defined service level objective.
expected_value: true for every lifecycle event
evidence_sources: HR feed reconciliation; identity change log
notes: Service level objective must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Least privilege role assignment
assertion: Assigned roles do not exceed the approved role baseline for the account owner and workload purpose.
expected_value: true for every role assignment
evidence_sources: Role inventory; access request approvals
notes: Role baseline is maintained outside this index.

title: Administrative separation of duties
assertion: Conflicting privileged duties are not assigned to the same identity without documented approval.
expected_value: false unless exception is approved
evidence_sources: Role matrix; exception register
notes: Conflict matrix must be supplied by the control owner.

title: Privileged access review cadence
assertion: Privileged access assignments have been reviewed within the approved review interval.
expected_value: less than or equal to review interval
evidence_sources: Access review campaign export; reviewer attestation
notes: Review interval must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Conditional access baseline
assertion: Privileged and remote access is covered by approved conditional access or equivalent policy.
expected_value: coverage is true for in-scope access paths
evidence_sources: Conditional access policy export; identity sign-in logs
notes: Applies to providers that support conditional access policy export.

title: Service account ownership
assertion: Service accounts have an accountable owner and documented business purpose.
expected_value: owner and purpose are present for service accounts
evidence_sources: Service account inventory; CMDB record
notes: Service account classification is supplied by the collector or enrichment stage.

title: Service account secret rotation
assertion: Service account credentials are rotated within the approved maximum age.
expected_value: less than or equal to maximum age
evidence_sources: Credential inventory; vault rotation logs
notes: Maximum age must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Break-glass account governance
assertion: Break-glass accounts are minimal monitored and covered by current approval records.
expected_value: monitored and approval_current are true for every break-glass account
evidence_sources: Break-glass register; alert configuration; access review
notes: Break-glass count threshold is set outside this index.

title: MFA for privileged accounts
assertion: MFA is enabled for all privileged accounts.
expected_value: true for every account where accounts[].privileged is true
evidence_sources: IAM or Entra account snapshot; MFA registration export
notes: Implemented Rego assertion evaluates the collector-normalised accounts array.

title: Standing privileged access elimination
assertion: Privileged accounts do not have standing privileged access.
expected_value: false for every account where accounts[].privileged is true
evidence_sources: IAM or Entra privilege assignment snapshot; PIM or JIT export
notes: Implemented Rego assertion evaluates the collector-normalised accounts array.

title: Approved configuration baseline
assertion: System configuration items are linked to an approved hardened baseline.
expected_value: baseline_approved is true for every in-scope resource
evidence_sources: Baseline registry; cloud configuration snapshot
e8_maturity: Configure Microsoft Office Macro Settings - ML3
notes: Baseline content is maintained outside this index.

title: Configuration drift detection
assertion: Production resources do not drift from the approved baseline beyond documented exceptions.
expected_value: drift_status is compliant unless exception_approved is true
evidence_sources: Configuration scanner output; exception register
notes: Drift scanner source is platform-specific.

title: Change approval linkage
assertion: Material configuration changes are linked to approved change records.
expected_value: approved is true and change_id is present
evidence_sources: Change management export; deployment metadata
notes: Materiality threshold must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Asset classification completeness
assertion: In-scope assets have owner environment data classification and criticality metadata.
expected_value: all required metadata fields are present
evidence_sources: Asset inventory; CMDB extract
apra_cps220: CPS 220 risk profile and asset inventory
notes: Classification taxonomy is maintained outside this index.

title: Secure logging configuration
assertion: In-scope systems emit security logs to the approved central logging destination.
expected_value: true for every in-scope resource
evidence_sources: Cloud logging configuration; SIEM ingestion inventory
notes: Retention requirements are asserted separately.

title: Log retention baseline
assertion: Security logs are retained for at least the approved retention period.
expected_value: greater than or equal to required retention days
evidence_sources: SIEM retention settings; storage lifecycle policy
notes: Required retention period must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Encryption at rest
assertion: In-scope data stores use approved encryption at rest.
expected_value: true for every in-scope data store
evidence_sources: Cloud resource configuration; KMS key inventory
notes: Key approval criteria are maintained outside this index.

title: Encryption in transit
assertion: Externally reachable services enforce approved TLS configuration.
expected_value: true for every externally reachable endpoint
evidence_sources: TLS scanner output; load balancer configuration
notes: TLS policy version must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Vulnerability remediation SLA
assertion: Critical and high vulnerabilities are remediated within approved service levels.
expected_value: within_sla is true for critical and high findings
evidence_sources: Vulnerability scanner export; ticketing system evidence
notes: Severity taxonomy and SLA thresholds must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Critical system backup coverage
assertion: Critical systems have successful backup jobs within the approved recovery point objective.
expected_value: less than or equal to RPO for critical systems
evidence_sources: Backup platform job report; asset criticality inventory
notes: Recovery point objective is supplied by the business continuity profile.

title: Immutable backup protection
assertion: Backup copies for critical systems are immutable or protected from privileged overwrite for the required retention window.
expected_value: immutable is true and retention_days meets requirement
evidence_sources: Backup vault policy; object lock or immutability configuration
notes: Retention window must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Backup restoration testing
assertion: Restoration tests are completed and evidenced within the required interval.
expected_value: result is pass and age is within interval
evidence_sources: Restore test records; incident exercise evidence
notes: Test interval must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Backup failure alerting
assertion: Backup job failures generate monitored alerts routed to an accountable operations queue.
expected_value: true for every in-scope backup job
evidence_sources: Backup platform alert settings; on-call routing config
notes: Alert route approval is maintained outside this index.

title: Incident response plan currency
assertion: Incident response plans are reviewed and approved within the required interval.
expected_value: approved is true and review_age_days is within interval
evidence_sources: Incident response plan register; approval record
notes: Review interval must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Incident exercise completion
assertion: Incident response exercises are completed within the required interval and produce tracked actions.
expected_value: age is within interval and actions_tracked is true
evidence_sources: Exercise report; action register
notes: Exercise interval must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Security incident triage SLA
assertion: Security alerts are triaged within the approved service level objective.
expected_value: within_sla is true for every in-scope alert
evidence_sources: SIEM alert export; case management records
notes: Service level objective must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Forensic evidence preservation
assertion: Incident evidence artefacts are preserved with integrity metadata and restricted access.
expected_value: true for every evidence artefact
evidence_sources: Case evidence register; hash manifest; access control export
notes: Complements but does not replace legal evidence handling requirements.

title: Supplier security classification
assertion: Suppliers are classified by service criticality data access and security risk.
expected_value: all required classification fields are present
evidence_sources: Supplier register; procurement risk assessment
notes: Classification taxonomy is maintained outside this index.

title: Supplier control assurance currency
assertion: Critical suppliers have current security assurance evidence.
expected_value: assurance_age_days is within threshold for critical suppliers
evidence_sources: Supplier assurance report; questionnaire or attestation
apra_cps220: CPS 220 control assurance for service providers
notes: Threshold must be declared in the assessment profile.

title: Cloud service approval
assertion: Cloud services are approved before production use and linked to accountable owners.
expected_value: approved is true and owner is present
evidence_sources: Cloud service register; architecture approval
notes: Approval workflow remains outside this index.

title: Software provenance evidence
assertion: Production software artefacts include provenance metadata and integrity verification.
expected_value: true for every production artefact
evidence_sources: Build provenance; signing verification logs
notes: Applies where build systems can emit provenance metadata.

title: AI system inventory
assertion: AI systems and model-enabled features are registered with owner purpose and risk classification.
expected_value: all required metadata fields are present
evidence_sources: AI system register; architecture inventory
apra_cps220: CPS 220 risk profile and control inventory
notes: Framework tags are governance analogues because AI-specific framework mappings are not authoritative in this repository.

title: Model data handling approval
assertion: AI systems use approved data sources and documented data handling constraints.
expected_value: true for every AI system
evidence_sources: Data source approval; privacy assessment; model card
notes: Privacy legal conclusions remain outside this index.

title: Prompt and output logging controls
assertion: AI interactions in production are logged according to approved retention and privacy constraints.
expected_value: true for every production AI system
evidence_sources: Application telemetry config; logging approval record
notes: Logging must respect data minimisation requirements.

title: Human escalation for high-risk AI outputs
assertion: High-risk AI workflows include a documented human review or escalation control.
expected_value: human_review_required is true for high-risk workflows
evidence_sources: Workflow design record; control attestation
notes: Does not assert automated decision-law compliance.

title: AI abuse monitoring
assertion: AI systems have abuse detection signals and response routing for security-relevant misuse.
expected_value: true for every production AI system
evidence_sources: Abuse monitoring configuration; incident routing record
notes: Signal design is platform-specific.

title: Model change governance
assertion: Model prompt retrieval or policy changes are linked to approved change records before production release.
expected_value: approved is true and change_id is present
evidence_sources: Model registry; prompt repository; change record
notes: Applies to model and AI application lifecycle changes.
